description: P6 field-mapping N[id] / D5 / X09: an instance annotation placement selection. mode=preferred means the offset is a suggestion the solver may change (recording the adopted rule and result); mode=fixed means the offset is binding and the solver must not move it. Geographic anchors come from data evidence, never from this placement; the solved position is a derived value, not a new business fact. Offsets use discriminated symbol measurements. Closed.
